items.title: What Could Lam Research (LRCX) Change With Its $15 Million STEM Education Push?
items.summary: Lam Research (NasdaqGS:LRCX) announced a US$15 million global STEM education partnership on 13 November 2026. The company will become a founding sponsor of a new global LEGO League initiative focused on hands-on STEM learning for students. The funding is aimed at supporting science and engineering education programs across multiple countries through classroom and competition-based activities.
